The wave cutoff has exact support; only a compact set is used in the local heat comparison.

Grey: uncut Gaussian. Red: normalized compact wave density.
B. Compact support of the relative matrix
p₀=p₁=p∞ outside compact K ⊂ V.
Group propagation: at most 3δ for each eᵢ(t).
Causal equality ⇒ e₀(t)−e₁(t)=0 off K′.
K′=H₆δ K is compact; μ(K′)<∞.
H₆δ: closed right-invariant group metric ball.
No ambient distance on V enters this support bound.
Relative difference: smooth compact arrow kernel.
Lemma 8.19; Proposition 8.20; eqs. (64)–(66).
C. Exact idempotent and a nonscalar exterior reference
S₀=1−QD; S₁=1−DQ; DS₀=S₁D; QS₁=S₀Q.
e = [ S₀² , S₀(1+S₀)Q ; S₁D , 1−S₁² ] satisfies e²=e.
Jf = [ f , 1−f ; 1−f , f ]; Jf²=I; ẽ=Jf diag(e,1−f)Jf.
ẽ−diag(I,0) = Jf diag(e−f,0)Jf ∈ A; τ(ẽ−diag(I,0))=τ(e−f).
Only e−f is integrated. Finite trace follows from the compact smooth-kernel factorization.
Proposition 8.20; eqs. (66)–(68); transverse-measure lesson, Lemma 7.9.

The characteristic difference is supported in K.

Theorem 8.21; eqs. (69)–(73). Individual heat integrals unused.

Circle: ker Q=0; ker Q*=ℂ1; Tr(ℂ1)=1.
Indτ(α⊠κ)=−Indτ(α).

Lift correction puts both defects in A⊗𝒦.
Proposition 8.22 and Theorem 8.23; eqs. (74)–(79).
All ranks: τ*(K₀(A)) = { ⟨ch x,CΛ⟩ : x ∈ Kcᵈ ᵐᵒᵈ ²(V) }.

Scope: G=V⋊H, H simply connected solvable; invariant locally finite transverse measure.
Human background: Connes; Blackadar; Gorokhovsky–Lott, Appendix A (proper cocompact scope).
